The '''Trevura droid resistance''' was a resistance group that operated on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Trevura]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Trevura, [[Merno Blask]], was anti-[[Droid/Legends|droid]] and made life on the planet very difficult for them. A group of them formed an underground resistance movement that opposed his rule and they hired the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[S-R6]] to kill him.
